main.description: How an author or publication presents itself as a standalone site — a page with none of Standard Reader's own chrome. One record per site: the author's own site (record key `self`, covering everything they publish) or one publication's site (record key derived from the publication's AT-URI). Absent means the site still renders, in the default style, with no customization.

publication.description: AT-URI of the site.standard.publication this site presents. Absent for the author's own site, which covers every publication they write for.

style.description: Which presentation the site is laid out in: 'broadsheet' (newspaper front page), 'journal' (single quiet column), 'gallery' (cover-image grid), or 'marquee' (hero and selected work). An unknown value falls back to 'broadsheet'.

tagline.description: A short line under the site's name. Absent falls back to the publication's description or the author's bio.

theme.description: Colors the site is painted in. Absent means the publication's own theme for a publication site, and the default editorial palette for an author site.

links.description: Outbound links shown in the site's masthead — the author's other homes on the web.

showStandardReaderLink.description: Whether the footer links back to this account's Standard Reader page. Absent means true.

createdAt.description: When the site was first configured.

updatedAt.description: When the site was last edited.

theme.description: A site's four flat colors, mirroring site.standard.theme.basic so the same color science generates the full scale from them.

background.description: Page background, as a hex color (`#rgb` or `#rrggbb`).

foreground.description: Body text, as a hex color.

accent.description: Accent used for rules, links, and buttons, as a hex color.

accentForeground.description: Text drawn on top of the accent, as a hex color.

link.description: One outbound link in a site's masthead.
